mapper.select: select report_id as reportId, family_id as familyId, compare_time as compareTime, count_alert_type as countAlertType from report_daily where family_id = #{familyId} order by report_id desc limit 1
select report_id as reportId, family_id as familyId, compare_time as compareTime, count_alert_type as countAlertType from report_week where family_id = #{familyId} order by report_id desc limit 1
select report_id as reportId, family_id as familyId, compare_time as compareTime, count_alert_type as countAlertType from report_month where family_id = #{familyId} order by report_id desc limit 1
select user_id as familyId, user_name as familyName from users order by user_id asc
select coalesce(sum(watch_duration), 0) / 60 from viewing_history where user_id = #{familyId} and watch_time >= current_timestamp - (#{days} * interval '1 day')
select count(*) from alert_log a join viewing_history v on v.viewing_id = a.viewing_id where v.user_id = #{familyId} and v.watch_time >= current_timestamp - (#{days} * interval '1 day')
